name: agentic-os
description: Agent memory system for Claude Code: per-project .agent-memory/ store (learnings, decisions, tasks, patterns, identity), session-bootstrap + wrap-up as the supported two-call bracket, deterministic scripts for every store write, and two command hooks (SessionStart briefing via additionalContext, PostToolUse dirty-state tracker). Invoke skills via their slash commands (/agentic-os:wrap-up) — that is the path where the skill's model class applies.
